plan.change: Narrow bounded existing-work classifier to trusted base lifecycle active status only; reject frozen, released, candidate and unknown work states before any Plan-free rollout.
expectedChanges: Existing-work classifier reads trusted immutable base data/work-lifecycle.json as plain bounded JSON and requires exactly one id/path with status active before classifying local tweaks.
Rejected types are released, candidate, frozen, missing/duplicate/malformed/oversize lifecycle data, and status changes in same PR.
Keep prior single-work, <=4 files, patch/line/size caps and protected filenames, preserving no permissions to modify shared world.
Update real-git fixtures to include lifecycle registry, add positive active and negative frozen/candidate/released/unknown and malformed cases.
Leave privileged workflow pinned classifiers unchanged; this is no-op until independently authorized install.
ownerDecisions: Owner requested flexible prototypes and easy local tweaking but strict preservation of frozen and published works; staging-only machine fastpath under construction.
hqDecisions: Limit eventually Plan-free existing work scope to active/lifecycle-known works only, not public/frozen/candidate. A manual decision is still needed for riskier states.
Do not allow candidate to alter lifecycle manifest in same PR and do not allow unknown id fallback.
Trusted base source must be immutable Git blob, never parse candidate-controlled status or launch script.
manualChecks: Review fixture coverage for four lifecycle states and malformed base
Review exact git base-state lookup does not consult candidate manifest
dependencies: Work lifecycle schema source status active
plan.rollback: Revert this staging classifier change; not yet referenced by any privileged fastpath.
outOfScope: Activate light workflow in same PR
unverified: No Plan-free existing-work route authorized until protected workflow transition and live negative canary
alternativesRejected: Allow all status values for the same small work path
Read candidate untrusted registry for scope exemptions
Treat exact historical revert as author permission

plan.problem: Current proof classifier only checks path locality, potentially treating frozen or released works as safe, against the author's preservation rules.
plan.currentContract: Existing works have lifecycle states active/frozen/candidate/released; public/frozen should not receive automatic relaxed routing.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: File path and line count cannot distinguish work lifecycle and author expectations; status must be read from trusted base, not candidate.
plan.design: Require matching active state from exact base lifecycle blob, valid schema, unique id/path and bounded JSON, before existing file diff acceptance.
plan.migration: Proof-only change first. Recompute pinned blob for any future privileged workflow and separately preauthorize exact blob transitions; no gate change this PR.
plan.compatibility: Current new-work classifier, old existing-work full Plan gate, all production/legacy states unchanged.
plan.promotionRisk: Status active does not authorize production; staged classifier result remains limited evidence.
